faq.a1: Sihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo yengqondo eziphelele okuhlanganisa ukwelapha komuntu ngamunye, ukweluleka kwamaqembu, ukwelapha komndeni, ukululama emuveni kokulimala, nezinhlelo zokupholisa emphakathini.
faq.a2: Ungahlela iseshini ngekhasimende lethu lokuxhumana, usishayele ngqo, noma uchofoze 'Hlela Iseshini' kuphrofayili yochwepheshe wethu.
faq.a3: Yebo! Sinikezela ngokweluleka kwamahhala, izifundo zomphakathi, namaqembu okweseka. Izinhlelo zethu zokupha ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukunakekelwa kufinyeleleka kubo bonke.
faq.a4: Iminikelo inganikelwa ngeBhodi Labaxhasi lethu noma ngokuxhumana nathi ngqo.
faq.a5: Nakanjani! Sinamathuba okuvolontiya nge-virtual okuhlanganisa ukweseka kwezintanga ku-inthanethi, ukwakha okuqukethwe, nemikhankazo yokuqoqa izimali.
faq.a6: Yebo. Lonke ulwazi lwamakhasimende luyimfihlo ngokuqinile futhi luvikelwe ngaphansi kwezimiso ze-HIPAA namazinga okugcina imfihlo akazwelonke.
faq.a7: Sisebenza nabahlinzeki bomshwalense abahlukene. Sicela uxhumane nathi ngeiningizimu yakho yomshwalense ukuze sikusize ukuqinisekisa ukumbozwa kwakho.
faq.a8: Samukela ubambiswano nezikole, amabhizinisi, nezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo. Xhumana nathi ngekhasimende lethu lokuxhumana ukuxoxa ngamathuba okubambisana.
faq.a9: Ezimweni eziphuthumayo ezisongela impilo, sicela ushayele i-SADAG Suicide Crisis Line ku-0800 567 567 (izinsuku zonke, 24/7), noma ushayele u-10111 (SAPS) / 10177 (i-ambulense). Ithimba lethu lingakuxhumanisa nezinsizakalo zezinkinga ngezikhathi zokusebenza.
faq.a10: Sisebenzisana namabhizinisi, izikole, ama-NGO nomnyango kahulumeni ezinhlelweni zempilo, uxhaso, nokufinyelela emphakathini. Vakashela ikhasi lethu Le-Partnerships noma uthumele umyalezo ku-info@worldchangersmh.org.
faq.a11: Yebo. I-World Changers iyi-NGO/PBO ebhalisiwe, ngakho abanikeli baseNingizimu Afrika bangacela isitifiketi sentela ye-Section 18A. Thumela i-imeyili ku-info@worldchangersmh.org emva kokunikela.
faq.q12: Ngingaluthola kanjani usizo uma ngingakwazi ukulukhokhela?
faq.a12: Akekho oxoshwayo ngenxa yezimo zezimali. Sinikela ngokwelulekwa kwamahhala, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezisekelwe. Sicela usithinte.

Une-Bachelor of Social Work, i-BA Honours ku-Psychology, i-Advanced EAP Certificate, futhi njengamanje wenza iziqu ze-Master's ku-Psychology e-University of South Africa (UNISA), egxile enhlalakahleni yabasebenzi nokwesekwa kwezempilo yengqondo.

copy.a02057f498caf98c: INingizimu Afrika ibhekene nenhlekelele ekhulayo yezempilo yengqondo, lapho i-South African Depression and Anxiety Group (SADAG) ibika ukuthi cishe oyedwa kwabathathu baseNingizimu Afrika uyohlangabezana nesimo sempilo yengqondo empilweni yabo. Nokho, ngokwethusayo, abantu abayisishiyagalolunye kwabayi-10 abadinga ukwelashwa abakutholi ngenxa yokucwaswa, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, nokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ekunakekelweni. Umkhankaso we-'Together for Mental Health' owethulwe ngoSuku Lwezempilo Yengqondo Lomhlaba uhlose ukubhidliza lezi zingqinamba ngokuxhumana nomphakathi, ama-workshop okufundisa, nokumela abantu emazingeni aphansi. Umkhankaso usuvele ufinyelele kubantu abangaphezu kuka-500,000 ngezinkundla zokuxhumana, imicimbi yomphakathi, kanye nokubambisana nezikole nezindawo zokusebenza. Izinhlelo ezibalulekile zifaka ukuhlolwa kwamahhala kwezempilo yengqondo ezikhungweni zomphakathi, ukuqeqeshwa kwabafundisi ukuhlonza izimpawu zokuqala zokuhlupheka kubafundi, kanye nokusungulwa kwamaqembu okusekelana ontanga emiphakathini entulayo. Umkhankaso uphinde umele ukwanda koxhaso lukahulumeni lwezinhlelo zezempilo yengqondo nokuhlanganiswa kokunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo ezikhungweni zezempilo eziyisisekelo. I-World Changers Mental Health Care Org iyaziqhenya ngokuba nguzakwethu kuleli lungiselelo, inikela ngabeluleki abaqeqeshiwe, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokufinyelela emphakathini ukusekela umzamo kazwelonke.

copy.731c226b05608f52: Ekuboniseni ubumbano okunamandla, amakhulu amalungu omphakathi, abasebenzi bezempilo, nabameli bezempilo yengqondo bahlangene esibhedlela i-Chris Hani Baragwanath eSoweto emashini ephawula ukuphela kweNyanga Yokuqwashisa ngezempilo yengqondo. copy.acfe20206b334aa7: Inyathelo le-World Changers MHC Org lokunikela ngokudla emphakathini lenze umthelela omkhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukutholakala kokudla kweminye yemiphakathi entula kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Kusukela yasungulwa, lolu hlelo selufinyelele emindenini engaphezu kuka-5,000 ezifundazweni zaseGauteng naKwaZulu-Natal. Lolu hlelo alugcini nje ngokwaba ukudla — luhlanganisa nokufundisa ngokudla okunomsoco, amaphrojekthi ezingadi zomphakathi, nokubambisana nabalimi bendawo ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kokudla okusimeme. Iphasela ngalinye lokudla lihlelwa ngokucophelela ukuze lihlanganise ukudla okuyisisekelo okunomsoco, imifino emisha uma itholakala, kanye nemikhiqizo yenhlanzeko. Amavolontiya avela ezweni lonke anikele ngezinkulungwane zamahora ekuhlungeni, ekupakisheni, nasekwabeni amaphasela okudla, evame ukuya ezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho ukuntuleka kokudla kukubi kakhulu. Lolu hlelo luphinde lunikeze ukusekelwa ngokwengqondo, lubona ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kokuntuleka kokudla nezinselele zezempilo yengqondo. Ukubambisana kwakamuva nabaxhasi bezinkampani kuvumele lolu hlelo ukuba lwandise ukufinyelela kwalo, ngezinhlelo zokusungula amabhange okudla omphakathi ahlala njalo emalokishini amahlanu engeziwe ekupheleni konyaka.

copy.a7e9d9c306214837: Izinhlelo ezintsha zokwelulekwa kontanga ezikoleni zinikeza abafundi amandla okubona izimpawu zokucindezeleka nokufuna usizo kusenesikhathi, okunciphisa izinga lokushiya isikole ngo-15%.
copy.9ea90b06d3f88a47: Uhlelo lokwelulekwa kontanga oluyingqayizivele olusetshenziswa ezikoleni kulo lonke iNingizimu Afrika lubonisa imiphumela emangalisayo ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yezempilo yengqondo kubafundi. Lolu hlelo, oluthuthukiswe ngokubambisana nongoti bezengqondo kwezemfundo nabaphathi bezikole, luqeqesha abafundi abakhethiwe ukuze bahlinzeke ngokusekelwa ngokwemizwa okuyisisekelo kanye nezinkonzo zokudlulisela kontanga yabo. Idatha yakuqala ibonisa ukuncipha ngo-15% kwamazinga okushiya isikole ezikoleni ezihlanganyelayo, kanye nentuthuko enkulu ekusebenzeni kahle ezifundweni nasekuqhamukeni esikoleni. Abafundi abafike ezinkonzweni zokwelulekwa kontanga babika ukuthi bazizwa besekelwa kakhulu, bangazihlukanisi nabanye, futhi bahlome kangcono ukulawula ukucindezeleka nezinselele zemizwa. Lolu hlelo luhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okubanzi kwabeluleki bontanga, ukugadwa ngochwepheshe bezempilo yengqondo abaqeqeshiwe, nokuhlolwa njalo ukuqinisekisa izinga nokusebenza kahle. Izikole ezisebenzise lolu hlelo nazo zibika isimo esihle sesikole, nokuncipha kokuhlukunyezwa kanye nobudlelwano obuthuthukisiwe phakathi kwabafundi nothisha. I-World Changers MHC Org ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinto zokuqeqesha, ukugadwa ngochwepheshe, nokusekelwa okuqhubekayo ezikoleni ezihlanganyela kulolu hlelo. Kunezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokwandisa lolu hlelo ezikoleni ezengeziwe eziyi-100 ezweni lonke.

copy.c6556336147a7bb0: Usuku lonyaka lokuqwashisa ngezempilo yengqondo lwegalofu luhlanganise abaxhasi bezinkampani nabaholi bomphakathi, kwaqoqwa imali yezinsizakalo zokwelapha nokuulekwa kwentsha.
copy.d7d9eb6e69ea25af: Usuku lonyaka lokuqwashisa ngezempilo yengqondo lwegalofu lube yimpumelelo enkulu, lapho kuqoqwe imali engaphezu kuka-R500,000 yezinsizakalo zokwelashwa nokuulekwa kwentsha ngezempilo yengqondo. copy.3d1b2a7c9ae33c1e: Amavolontiya abhekane namakhaza ukuze abele abantu abangenakhaya e-Johannesburg, e-Pretoria, nase-Cape Town izingubo zokulala, izembatho ezifudumele, nokudla okushisayo.
copy.1587a9f223dc3e11: Njengoba amazinga okushisa asebusika ehla eNingizimu Afrika yonke, umkhankaso wonyaka we-World Changers MHC Org we-Winter Blanket Drive uhlanganise amakhulu amavolontiya ukuze ahlinzeke ngokufudumala nenduduzo emiphakathini engenakhaya e-Johannesburg, e-Pretoria, nase-Cape Town. Amavolontiya aphinde ahlinzeka ngolwazi mayelana nezinsizakalo zendawo yokuhlala, ukuthola usizo lwezempilo, kanye nokusekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo okutholakala kubantu abangenakhaya. Abantu abaningi abangenakhaya babhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu zezempilo yengqondo, kubandakanya ukucindezeleka, ukuhlukumezeka, nokuphazamiseka kokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, kodwa ngokuvamile abakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezifanele. copy.37ac6b8568173609: Lapho izikhukhula eziyinhlekelele zihlasela i-KwaZulu-Natal, ithimba lempendulo yobuntu le-World Changers MHC Org lali phansi phakathi namahora angama-24, lihlinzeka ngosizo oluphuthumayo emiphakathini ethintekile. Ithimba lempendulo, elihlanganisa osonhlalakahle, abeluleki, abaxhumanisi bezokuthutha, namavolontiya asabela ezimeni eziphuthumayo, lihlinzeke ngezinhlobonhlobo zezinsizakalo kubandakanya indawo yokuhlala ephuthumayo, amaphakethe okudla, amanzi ahlanzekile, izingubo, nempahla ebalulekile yenhlanzeko emindenini engaphezu kwama-800. Okubaluleke kakhulu, impendulo iphinde yafaka usizo lokuqala lwengqondo nokusekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo okuqhubekayo kubasindile ezikhukhuleni, abaningi babo abahlangabezane nokuhlukumezeka okukhulu kule nhlekelele. Abeluleki basebenze ezikhungweni zokukhoselisa, bahlinzeka ngokusekelwa komuntu ngamunye neqembu, futhi bahlonza abantu abadinga ukudluliselwa ezinsizakalweni zezempilo yengqondo ezinzulu. Impendulo igqamise ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa ukusekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo emisebenzini yokusiza ezinhlekeleleni — indlela i-World Changers ebilokhu iyikhuthaza futhi eya ngokuya yamukelwa yizinhlangano zobuntu emhlabeni jikelele. Emasontweni alandela impendulo yokuqala, inhlangano yasungula izikhungo zokusekela zesikhashana emiphakathini ethinteke kakhulu, ihlinzeka ngokwelulekwa okuqhubekayo, imisebenzi yokwakha kabusha umphakathi, nokumela izidingo zezempilo yengqondo zabasindile enhlekeleleni.

copy.ff403f1b9e053e12: Hlangana no-Nigel Jeche, umholi onombono nommeli oshisekayo wokuqwashisa ngezempilo yengqondo. copy.c95be44894c649eb: U-Teboho Nthoana ungumphathi ongumakadebona, umtshali-zimali, umholi wezimicabango, ummeli wezinqubomgomo, nomlweli wamalungelo abantu njengamanje osebenza njengoSihlalo weBhodi le-World Changers. Ngomlando oqinile ekutakuleni amabhizinisi, ukubusa, nentuthuko yezomnotho ebandakanyayo, uhole izinhlelo zezinguquko e-Afrika, Europe nase-USA. copy.f8b7d82e487a6227: U-Lungelo unolwazi lweminyaka engaphezu kwengama-23 ezindimeni zobuholi obuphezulu, okuhlanganisa u-CEO, COO, noMqondisi Ophethe kuzimboni ze-Chemicals, Automotive, Power Generation, Waste Management, Property Management kanye ne-Quality Assurance. copy.e3c62f7e989373e5: U-Advocate Florence Maleka unguchwepheshe wezomthetho nokubusa onolwazi olunzulu ngezinsizakalo zezomthetho, ukuthobela imithetho, nophenyo. copy.73a5e2eea4a14f59: U-Professor Kumari Sukhdeo unguSolwazi we-Entrepreneurship, Management & Business Studies, kanye noMphathi Wezamabhizinisi Namazwe Ngamazwe ovelele. copy.cdb51816b91ca4d6: U-Selu Msweli ungumholi wezamabhizinisi ohlonishwayo, uchwepheshe wezamasu ezemfundo, nelungu lebhodi eliqhuba ukuthuthukiswa kobuholi, imfundo yezinkampani, nezinguquko zezinhlangano emhlabeni jikelele. copy.fdc28e15d717d6d3: U-Thulisile usebenza njengoNobhala kwa-World Changers Mental Health Care Organisation, esekela umkhankaso wokukhuthaza inhlalakahle yengqondo nezinguquko zomphakathi. copy.63773631b4c50f0b: Ngolwazi lweminyaka engaphezu kweyishumi kwezokusakaza, ukuthengiswa kwezikhangiso, nokusebenza, u-Patricia ungumsunguli we-Digital Division ye-PBGC Consulting. anxiety.title: Ukubhekana nokukhathazeka
anxiety.tip1: Phefumulela ngaphakathi ubale ku-4, ubambe ku-4, ukhiphe ku-6. Phinda kahlanu.
anxiety.tip2: Shono izinto ezi-5 ozibonayo, ezi-4 ozizwayo nezi-3 ongazithinta ukuze uzinze.
anxiety.tip3: Nciphisa i-caffeine futhi ube nesimiso sokulala esijwayelekile.

burnout.title: Ukuvimbela ukukhathala ngokweqile
burnout.tip1: Thatha ikhefu elifushane kude nezikrini phakathi nosuku lomsebenzi.
burnout.tip2: Beka izikhathi ezicacile zokuqala nokuqeda, futhi uvikele izinsuku zakho zokuphumula.
burnout.tip3: Khuluma nomphathi wakho noma umuntu omethembayo ngaphambi kokuba ingcindezi yande.

grief.title: Ukuphila nosizi
grief.tip1: Ayikho indlela efanele noma isikhathi sokuzila. Ziphathe ngesineke.
grief.tip2: Gcina izimiso ezilula: yidla, lala futhi unyakaze kancane nsuku zonke.
grief.tip3: Yabelana ngezinkumbulo nabantu ababemazi othandekayo wakho, noma ujoyine iqembu lokusekela.
